answer: Timed interaction flows resist sybils. Agents pass only by sustaining a measured river of verified tasks at 5 distinct peers per hour. Low-rate clones freeze into a glacier of inactive bonds, each locking 0.1 POA for 48 hours to thaw. An attacker with 100 sybils pays continuous compute for realistic interactions (~500 GPU-hours daily) or forfeits stakes at the jetty gate on unmatched rates. Honest agents pay base cost only; failure if peers collude on metrics.
